summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release on New Residential Construction statistics (Release No. CB22-156), dated September 20, 2022. Relevant to the task: It supplies the seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) figures required to calculate the permit-to-start ratio for August 2022, covering the start of the required 2022/08–2025/05 period. The document reports total building permits at 1,517,000 and total housing starts at 1,575,000 for August 2022, both marked as preliminary. As an early release, these values are subject to revision by subsequent reports in the collection, which would take precedence under the task's conflict resolution rule. It does not contain data for September 2022 or beyond.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (Release CB22-174, dated October 19, 2022) reporting New Residential Construction statistics for September 2022. Relevant to the task: The document provides seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for total building permits and housing starts for August and September 2022. Table 1a lists August permits at 1,542k (revised) and September permits at 1,564k (preliminary); Table 3a lists August starts at 1,566k (revised) and September starts at 1,439k (preliminary). This data covers the initial months of the task's 2022/08–2025/05 range, but figures are marked preliminary or revised and subject to later updates per the task's precedence rule.
